problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $P,$ given by

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -6 & -4 & 9 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $P$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -6 & -4 & 9 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $P$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
